summary: Two commits over 6fac2d1, each checked by the fresh-context reviewer of its area. Resume record timing (8e470df, the orchestrator's one-line change after a full run failed once in App.cardMenu; reviewer aebb4273): lows-only; root cause confirmed (the record's ref was mirrored in a passive effect while the Resume label is drawn from state, so a press between the commit and the effect played from zero), the layout effect closes the window, the profile-switch reset still holds; low: LibraryView keeps the same passive mirror, where it gives a dead click. Player files byte-identical to the reviewed commit; index.css differs only by another builder's unlanded rules.
